decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's coolant management offer and its publicly announced direction, so the firm keeps it and treats any soft results as temporary market weakness.
The cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's stated filtering and sustainability focus and has drawn investment, so management sees it through the current machinery downturn.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the established conveying business, and withdrawing one would contradict the firm's core identity.
Hinged belt conveyors are a standard core product central to the firm's material flow portfolio, so the firm keeps them despite the earlier pruning of related lines.
